tool_schemas.name: list_assistants
tool_schemas.description: Lists assistants in your account and returns a page of assistant records filtered by status and sorted by the requested field/order; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/pagination parameter is invalid (including limit out of range) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if your credentials cannot access assistants for the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of assistants to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_assistant
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new assistant with the provided display name, voice_config, and model_config, and returns the created assistant record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, status is not one of the allowed lifecycle values, or configuration objects are malformed, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not allowed to create assistants in the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

description.description: Description of what the assistant does.

voice_config.description: Voice configuration object for the assistant (provider/voice/settings).

model_config.description: Model configuration object for the assistant (model, prompts, parameters).

webhook_url.description: Webhook URL to receive assistant/call lifecycle events.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status of the assistant.

tool_schemas.name: get_assistant
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single assistant by assistant_id and returns the full assistant record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if assistant_id does not match the expected format, NOT_FOUND if no assistant with that ID exists in your account, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you do not have access to it. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

assistant_id.description: Unique ID of the assistant to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update_assistant
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing assistant by assistant_id and returns the updated assistant record with any provided fields applied. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if assistant_id is malformed, any provided field value is invalid, or the requested status value is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the assistant does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot modify it. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

assistant_id.description: Unique ID of the assistant to update.

display_name.description: Updated human-friendly name for the assistant.

description.description: Updated description of what the assistant does.

voice_config.description: Updated voice configuration object for the assistant.

model_config.description: Updated model configuration object for the assistant.

webhook_url.description: Updated webhook URL to receive assistant/call lifecycle events.

status.description: Updated lifecycle status of the assistant.

tool_schemas.name: list_calls
tool_schemas.description: Lists outbound calls in your account and returns a page of call records filtered by assistant, originating phone number, destination E.164, and/or call status; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/pagination parameter is invalid (including malformed IDs or limit out of range) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot access calls for the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

from_phone_number_id.description: Filter calls by originating (from) phone number ID.

to_e164.description: Filter calls by destination E.164 number.

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_call
tool_schemas.description: Creates an outbound call for the specified assistant to the destination to_e164 and returns the created call record, optionally using a specific owned from_phone_number_id or an allowed from_e164_override and attaching metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs are malformed, or to_e164/from_e164_override are not valid E.164 values, NOT_FOUND if the referenced assistant_id or from_phone_number_id does not exist, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you are not permitted to place calls for the account. Raises CONFLICT if the call cannot be created due to an invalid call state request (e.g., attempting to create a call against a non-usable assistant/number status), and RATE_LIMITED when call/request quotas are exceeded.

assistant_id.description: Assistant ID that will place and run the outbound call.

from_phone_number_id.description: Owned phone number ID to place the call from.

from_e164_override.description: Optional E.164 caller ID override (if allowed by provider/account).

to_e164.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to attach to the call for tracking.

tool_schemas.name: get_call
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single call by call_id and returns its current details and lifecycle state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if call_id does not match the expected format, NOT_FOUND if no call with that ID exists in your account, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you do not have access to it. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

call_id.description: Unique ID of the call to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_phone_numbers
tool_schemas.description: Lists phone numbers attached to your account and returns a page of phone number records filtered by status, provider, and/or country code; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/pagination parameter is invalid (including limit out of range or invalid country code) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot access phone numbers for the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

provider.description: Filter phone numbers by telephony provider.

country_code.description: Filter phone numbers by ISO country code (e.g., US, GB).

limit.description: Maximum number of phone numbers to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort_by.description: Field to sort phone numbers by.

tool_schemas.name: get_phone_number
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single phone number by phone_number_id and returns its details, including provider and current status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if phone_number_id does not match the expected format, NOT_FOUND if no phone number with that ID exists in your account, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you do not have access to it. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

phone_number_id.description: The ID of the phone number to fetch (e.g., vapi_pn_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

tool_schemas.name: list_tools
tool_schemas.description: Lists callable tools in the catalog and returns a page of tool records filtered by integration_type, status, and/or exact slug; results are paginated with limit and an opaque cursor, and the response includes a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter/sort/pagination parameter is invalid (including limit out of range) and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you cannot access the tools catalog for the account. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single tool by ID and returns the tool’s full definition and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if tool_id is missing or does not match the required vapi_tool_… format, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller does not have access to the tool’s owning account, and NOT_FOUND if no tool with that ID exists.

tool_id.description: The ID of the tool to fetch (e.g., vapi_tool_01H8XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX).

metadata.name: Vapi MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores configuration for voice AI assistants, the phone numbers attached to an account, and the lifecycle of outbound calls placed through those assistants. It also catalogs callable “tools” that assistants can invoke, and tracks which tools are enabled per assistant so the API can list
